ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of shareholders, UBOs, s, and any beneficial controller against: (a) the French national asset-freezing list (Arrêté du gel des avoirs, Article L562-1 CMF); (b) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (including all Council Regulations implementing UN Security Council resolutions); (c) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (d) the OFAC SDN List and OFAC Sectoral Sanctions Identifications List (best-practice adoption by French banks where SWIFT wire target rails are used); (e) TRACFIN typology indicators. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) must be screened per the FATF Recommendation 12 definition and Articles L561-10 and R561-10 to R561-13 CMF, requiring Enhanced Due Diligence, heightened monitoring and senior-management approval for the business relationship. Negative news and adverse-media checks on every UBO must be documented and archived for at least 5 years following the termination of the relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); publication and RCS records at the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce and the Infogreffe registry (infogreffe.fr); national company name database maintained by INPI.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SARL name may be expressed in any language but must be composed entirely of Latin-script characters for registration in the RCS. All statutory filings, the articles of association (statuts), and the registration form must be submitted in French; any non-French translation attached without legal force is permissible for information only. The corporate name must be followed by the words 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or the abbreviation 'SARL' in all deeds, letters, invoices and plaques. The name must comply with Article R123-56 of the Commercial Code (absence of identity or confusing similarity with a mark, trade name or prior company name recorded in the national INPI/Infogreffe database and with protected trademarks). Transliteration of a foreign-language name into Latin characters is accepted without formal transliteration certificate, but the sworn translation of the certificate of availability may be requested by the registry if the proposed name contains accented characters or ligatures.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: SA (as a standalone suffix or prefix suggesting a public limited company)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal by the Guichet unique or by the Registrar of the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce, the applicant must obtain written notification of the grounds of refusal. Administrative appeal: submit a written reconsideration request to the Direction de l'INPI (Pôle Registres, Retraitements et Données) within 15 days of the notification, accompanied by a fresh availability certificate from the INPI database and any evidence rebutting the alleged identity/confusing-similarity finding. Judicial appeal: file a petition (recours en contestation) before the President of the Tribunal judiciaire or Tribunal de commerce in whose jurisdiction the registered office will be located, per Articles L123-4-2 and R123-12 of the Commercial Code, no later than 15 days after the administrative denial, requesting an order compelling registration. In parallel, trademark and trade-name opposition relief lies under Articles L711-4 and L716-1 to L716-3 of the Code de la propriété intellectuelle if a third party asserts prior rights. A new filing may be resubmitted immediately if only minor objections are raised, without losing priority if the objection is re-filed within the 30-day validity window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible under Articles L123-11-1 to L123-16 of the Commercial Code by entering into a domiciliation agreement with a duly licensed business domiciliation company (société de domiciliation), which must be recorded by the Greffe with the domiciliaire's registration number. For an ISIC 4210 rail-transit EPC contractor relying on government bonds and SWIFT wire payments, a virtual office is commercially accepted for formation, but French corporate residency for tax purposes requires effective management in France; the tax administration may recharacterise the registered office if there is no de facto local establishment, place of decisions, or staff. The EPC industry standard mandates a physical project office in France if the company will hold French public contracts, as public contracting entities require a real local presence for insurance cover and performance securities. Virtual domiciliation may not be used where the activity is contrary to public order, nor for certain regulated professions.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation and governance), and Decree No. 2020-106 (electronic filing procedures)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and M0 form (Déclaration de création d'entreprise)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital required for SARL; capital is freely determined by the partners, but must be fully subscribed and paid up in cash or in kind. For cash contributions, funds must be deposited in a blocked bank account (compte bloqué) until the company is registered, then released upon issuance of the K-bis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the shareholders, having reviewed the draft Statuts, hereby adopt the same and constitute the Société à Responsabilité Limitée. The capital of €[amount] is declared fully subscribed and paid in. The registered office is fixed at [address]. The shareholders appoint [Name] as Manager (Gérant) for an indefinite term, with full powers to act on behalf of the company within the corporate purpose. The Manager is authorized to complete all formalities, including registration with the RCS, and to open bank accounts. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) via the online portal 'Infogreffe'
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary search on the INPI database to ensure the proposed company name is not identical or confusingly similar to existing trademarks or corporate names. Optionally file a name reservation request (déclaration de réservation de nom) with the INPI, which is valid for 4 months. The name must be included in the draft statutes.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of the applicant
Power of attorney if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to conflict, submit a new name or file an opposition with the INPI within 2 months; otherwise, select an alternative name and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public (if real estate contribution) or private deed signed by all partners; registration with the tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in French, including corporate purpose (construction of urban light rail transit systems), registered office address, share capital, share distribution, management structure, and governance rules. All partners must sign the deed. If any contribution is in kind, a statutory auditor (commissaire aux apports) must value the contribution. The deed must be registered with the tax office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) within one month of signature.
required_dossiers: Proof of address of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax office queries the registration, correct any deficiencies and re-submit within 15 days; if notarization is required, engage a notary to rectify the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital in Blocked Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any French bank or financial institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the name of the company in formation. Deposit the full amount of cash contributions. The bank issues a certificate of deposit (attestation de blocage) confirming the funds are blocked until the company is registered. This certificate is required for the registration filing.
required_dossiers: Identity of the person depositing funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the deposit due to AML checks, provide additional source-of-funds documentation; if the deposit is insufficient, request partners to top up before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Legal Notice in a Journal of Legal Notices (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any authorized legal gazette (e.g., Les Affiches Parisiennes, Le Bulletin Officiel des Annonces Civiles et Commerciales - BODACC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a notice in a legal gazette authorized in the department of the registered office. The notice must include the company name, form (SARL), capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, and the name of the manager. Obtain a copy of the publication (attestation de parution) to include in the registration file.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication is delayed, request a rush service; if the notice contains errors, publish a corrective notice and obtain a new attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) via the online portal 'Infogreffe' or in person
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file to the RCS, including the signed Statuts, certificate of capital deposit, publication attestation, and the M0 form. The registry reviews the file and issues a K-bis extract (official certificate of registration) upon approval. The company is legally constituted on the date of registration.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of the manager
Declaration of non-conviction of the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query (e.g., missing document), respond within 15 days with the required corrections; if the application is rejected, appeal to the President of the Commercial Court within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (for SIREN/SIRET numbers), Tax Office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises), and URSSAF (social security)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the K-bis, the company automatically receives a SIREN number from INSEE. Register for corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) and VAT (TVA) with the tax office. Register with URSSAF for employer obligations. Open a permanent bank account and release the blocked funds.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or social registrations are delayed, contact the respective authorities; if the SIREN number is not issued, follow up with INSEE.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) and the Préfecture (for ICPE - Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'exploitation pour travaux de construction de lignes de transport ferroviaire (Operating permit for railway construction works) and ICPE authorization if applicable

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique (via DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report (Étude d'impact environnemental) required for projects exceeding 10 km of track or involving significant land disturbance; otherwise a simplified environmental assessment (Examen au cas par cas) may apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the French Environmental Code (Articles L.181-1 et seq.) and EU Directive 2011/92/EU. Wastewater discharge must meet limits for suspended solids (<30 mg/L), BOD5 (<25 mg/L), and pH 6-9. VOC emissions from asphalt and painting operations must not exceed 50 mg/m³. Construction waste must be segregated and disposed of in approved facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours (SDIS) for temporary structures and site offices; structural load inspections by a certified engineer for temporary bridges and gantries; workplace clearance from the Inspection du Travail (labor inspectorate) confirming compliance with occupational health and safety regulations (Code du travail).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) under the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; official portal: impots.gouv.fr (professional space); national e-invoicing platform: portail-public-facturation.gouv.fr; the Direction des Grandes Entreprises (DGE) handles the files of large taxpayers; non-resident VAT registration is processed by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE), 10 rue du Centre, 93193 Noisy-le-Grand.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Domestic SARL: incorporation is filed via the integrated business formalities portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) through the one-stop shop (Guichet Unique), which transmits to the commercial registry (Greffe du tribunal de commerce) and INSEE; INSEE issues the 9-digit SIREN and 14-digit SIRET identifiers, and DGFiP automatically allocates the intra-Community VAT number formatted FR + 2-digit key + 9-digit SIREN. Foreign entity establishing the SARL or operating directly in France with a fixed establishment: VAT registration is filed directly with the SIEE using Form Cerfa No. 14791 for non-established taxable persons, supported by certified articles of incorporation, proof of appointment of a French tax representative, identity/governance documents and evidence of the French establishment; processing time is approximately 2-4 weeks, and registration is a precondition for import zero-rating, intra-Community acquisition declarations and participation in government bond escrow payment rails.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - SARL is by default subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, Articles 206-209 CGI) at the 25% headline rate; profits and losses are confined to the entity, with no automatic pass-through to members; the territoriality principle (Article 209 paragraph 1 CGI) limits IS to profits of enterprises carried on in France, making the SARL a French tax-resident corporation for treaty purposes; no general tax-exempt-zone regime applies to urban light rail EPC activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (i) Five-year income-tax transparency election for newly created SARLs (Article 239 bis AA CGI), allowing pass-through taxation of profits at member level for the first five fiscal years; (ii) irreversible option for corporate income tax (Article 206(1) CGI) available to SARLs that are nominally transparent; (iii) French fiscal integration election (Article 223 A CGI) enabling a 95%+ French parent to consolidate SARL results; (iv) parent-subsidiary dividend exemption election (Article 145 CGI); (v) VAT election to waive the small-business franchise and register normally (Article 293 B CGI); (vi) mandatory VAT self-charging (reverse charge) for construction subcontracting regardless of any election (Article 283-2 CGI); no check-the-box hybrid election exists - EU ATAD 2 hybrid-mismatch adjustments (Articles 212 bis and 239 quater B CGI) apply automatically to neutralize deduction/non-inclusion mismatches.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), in conjunction with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) and the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for banking supervision and AML/CFT enforcement; the external financial relations and foreign-exchange regime is codified in Articles L151-1 et seq. of the Code Monétaire et Financier (CMF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility. France is a euro-area member and has abolished exchange controls. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are free, including dividend distributions, loan repayments, return of subscribed capital, and other profit remittances to non-resident shareholders. No prior administrative clearance, foreign-exchange budget, or convertibility licence is required for lawful remittances. Residual frictions arise only from (i) statistical balance-of-payments reporting to the Banque de France, (ii) EU/French sanctions screening, and (iii) the French Treasury prior-authorisation regime for certain third-country direct investments in sensitive sectors, which may affect the light-rail EPC contractor if a non-EEA investor acquires control over transport or critical-infrastructure activities (Décret n° 2019-1590, Articles R153-1 et seq. CMF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. French law imposes no statutory export-receipt repatriation deadline and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds. The SARL may retain foreign currency receivables in dedicated nostro accounts (comptes en devises) held with French or foreign banks after informing the payer; the proceeds must transit the regulated banking system and are captured in the bank's balance-of-payments reporting. In practice the SARL must keep the export customs declaration (déclaration d'échange de biens), commercial invoices, transport documents, and the underlying EPC contract available for substantiation during AML/KYC reviews and customs audits.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational EUR and USD Accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank (Crédit Agricole CIB)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Project Finance and Hedging Lines
Operational Account / Capital Markets and LC Services

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low as lead bank; Medium only as an ancillary euro payment channel for petty disbursements. An EU/EEA electronic-money institution (EMI) authorised by the ACPR or passported under PSD2 may open a settlement account, but it cannot hold escrowed funds because EMIs are prohibited from taking deposits and providing treasury/escrow services (Articles L525-1, L526-1 CMF). Non-EEA digital EMIs, including UK-based firms post-Brexit, have no passporting right into France and would require a local licensed branch or subsidiary, which defeats the purpose. Therefore the government-bond escrow, documentary credits, and FX hedging mandates must sit with a full-service French credit institution.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a professional SARL account, tier-1 French banks normally require the legal representative (gérant) and each authorised signatory to appear physically at the commercial branch. Where the gérant is non-resident, banks also demand notarised and apostilled identity documents, an original French-language power of attorney, proof of address, and a fresh extract of the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (KBIS) together with the beneficial-owner declaration (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs, RBE). Fully remote opening exists only through ACPR-compliant video identification combined with an eIDAS-qualified electronic signature, and is generally refused for structures with non-EEA UBOs or with a sensitive-sector EPC mandate. A French residential or business address for service of process is advisable to de-risk the interview process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident individual UBO or gérant cannot appear in person and presents uncertified copies only
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised and apostilled passport copies; French tax-residence certificate or equivalent; original tier-1 bank reference dated within three months; professional CV; wealth-source statement covering all subscription funds; eIDAS-qualified signature certificate if remote onboarding is attempted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or opaque group chain above the French SARL (interposed non-EEA holding entities)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified ownership chart signed by a statutory auditor; RCS extracts of every intermediate entity; UBO register extract of each entity; board resolutions approving the capital increase; legal opinion confirming the economic purpose of the chain and absence of shell-company indicators.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions/dual-use exposure in rail EPC procurement (catenary electrification, signalling, or track components sourced via high-risk jurisdictions)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DG Trésor - Service des biens à double usage (SBDU) export licence or written confirmation of non-dual-use classification; end-user certificates; purchase contracts and incoterms; customs declarations; freight and insurance documents; sanctions-screening clearance letters from suppliers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Government-bond escrow and public-authority counterparty flagged as politically-exposed or sovereign-risk exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official procurement award notice and concession agreement; legal opinion confirming the counterparty is a public-law entity outside EU/French sanctions; escrow deed; documentation of the issuer and ISIN of the government bonds; independent valuation of the collateral; source of the public funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound escrow or capital-injection wires with mismatched purpose codes or missing underlying contract
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed EPC contract and capital-increase resolution; notarised statutory modifications; bank account mandate matched to the BDR reporting code; sworn statement of the gérant confirming the commercial or capital nature; flow-of-funds schedule for each tranche.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders remit the subscription price by SWIFT MT103 to the SARL's dedicated euro account opened after the RBE filing. The payment instruction must cite the corporate resolution approving the capital increase and describe the remittance as apport en capital / augmentation de capital (capital contribution), not as a commercial loan, to avoid incorrect balance-of-payments classification. The French bank captures the operation in the monthly balance-of-payments report (relevé BDR) under the direct-investment heading; no prior approval applies to EU/EEA resident investors. For non-EEA investors, the DG Trésor prior authorisation or notification procedure for foreign investments in France may apply because rail transit is a sensitive transport-infrastructure sector; the bank will require the DG Trésor decision (or an exemption memorandum from French counsel) as a precondition to crediting the funds. Each wire is verified against the beneficial-owner statements and the escrow deed before the corresponding shares are recorded in the RCS.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements are executed via SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments and SWIFT MT202 for correspondent cover; euro payments to EU counterparties clear through TARGET2/SEPA, while USD and other major-currency payments use the correspondent banking network. For the EPC programme the preferred trade instruments are sight or deferred-payment documentary credits issued by the French bank under UCP 600, standby letters of credit under ISP 98, and first-demand guarantees (garantie à première demande) issued to the public authority. Government-bond escrow proceeds are released only against banker's confirmed acceptances, maturing LCs, or inspected supplier invoices, with transport, insurance, inspection, and customs evidence attached. FX conversion is booked at the bank's fixing only at the moment a foreign-currency invoice is presented, and every disbursement must match the approved project budget and the escrow release schedule.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (change à terme ferme) for EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, and EUR/CHF
Plain-vanilla FX options (calls and puts) on liquid euro pairs
FX swaps (swap cambiste) for short-term liquidity alignment between currencies
Cross-currency swaps (swap de devises) for long-term EPC receivables and debt-service hedging
Break forwards (change à terme avec option de sortie) for asymmetric budget protection

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) restricted to non-convertible or unavailability-of-delivery currencies for the SARL's emerging-market sub-suppliers; not required for the euro, which is freely convertible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Liasse Fiscale — Forms 2065-SD and 2050-series schedules) together with final corporate income tax balance payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending 31 December: electronic filing by 3 May of the following year; for off-calendar year-ends: within 3 months of the fiscal year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% late-filing surcharge of assessed tax, increased to 40% for unresolved formal notice and 80% for deliberate concealment; late-payment interest of 0.2% per month; additional 5% surcharge for unpaid balances beyond 30 days of the tax notice

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, notes to the accounts), statutory auditor's report when audit applies, and proposed profit appropriation — approved by shareholders then deposited as the Dépôt des Comptes Annuels
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) via the Guichet Unique (INPI) platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months of the fiscal year end; registration deposit within 7 months of the fiscal year end (typically 30 June approval and 31 July deposit for a 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine of up to €9,000 for directors under the Commercial Code; injunctive procedure before the Commercial Court with daily penalty payments (astreinte); repeated non-filing for two consecutive years triggers a registry alert and risk of judicial dissolution and strike-off from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ordinary General Meeting (AGO) — approval of accounts, discharge of the gérant, ratification of related-party agreements, and approval of management fees
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Statutory corporate records, with the minutes maintained in the Minute Book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year end; court extension available upon formal application to the Commercial Court
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The gérant is exposed to civil liability for management fault; any shareholder may obtain a court order appointing a judicial agent to convene the AGO at company expense; absence of approved accounts blocks the annual accounts deposit and may trigger tax-compliance defaults

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership declaration (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) — re-filed whenever a share transfer or control change occurs and re-confirmed by the registry at each formalities filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following any direct or indirect share transfer or change in control (>25% ownership or voting rights); annual re-verification occurs at the deposit of annual accounts and any company formality
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine of €7,500 for a natural person and €37,500 for the legal entity for failure to file or for false declarations; judicial suspension of voting rights of the undeclared beneficial owner; registry blockage of K-bis issuance and further corporate filings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business tax declaration and payment — Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE); Cotisation sur la Valeur Ajoutée des Entreprises (CVAE) is fully abolished as of reference year 2024 and no longer declared
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP — Service des Impôts des Entreprises; payment collected by the public accountant for the municipality and departmental chamber of commerce
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual CFE payment due by 15 December for the current-year assessment based on the professional rental value as at 1 January; declaration form 1447-C-SD required electronically when the taxable base or premises change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.2% per month; 10% surcharge for missing or late declaration and up to 40% for fraudulent undervaluation; enforced recovery through garnishment of bank accounts or attachment of business assets

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) when the SARL exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at fiscal year end: (i) total assets above €4,000,000; (ii) net turnover above €8,000,000; (iii) average workforce above 50 employees. Audit is also compulsory for companies controlling another entity, for excluded legal forms, and where the rail-EPC concession contract, state grantor, or project finance lender contractually imposes an audit opinion on the special purpose company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général — PCG) under the French Commercial Code regulations; the statutory annual accounts of a French SARL must be presented in accordance with PCG charts; IFRS is reserved for statutory consolidated financial statements of listed groups and is not available for the standalone SARL accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL maintains a register of beneficial owners identifying any natural person holding, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the share capital or voting rights or exercising control. Any share transfer or governance change must be re-declared to the Greffe within 30 days on the official DBE form; the register is certified as accurate at the annual accounts approval and is re-verified by the registry at each subsequent corporate formality. The gérant is personally liable for the completeness and accuracy of the beneficial-owner filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Managers (Registre des Gérants — appointment and removal records)
Minute Book (Registre des Décisions et Assemblées)
Register of Pledges and Security Interests (Registre des Nantissements)
Beneficial Ownership Register (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$330 – US$1,650 (€300 – €1,500) annually for commercial domiciliation, registered-office services and corporate-mail handling in metropolitan France, depending on the city and service level.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$6,600 – US$27,500 (€6,000 – €25,000) for a full statutory audit of a mid-size SARL meeting the compulsory-audit thresholds; US$2,200 – US$6,600 (€2,000 – €6,000) for an agreed-upon procedures engagement or statutory review where the SARL remains below the audit thresholds.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate; reduced 15% on first €48,000 of taxable profit for companies with turnover < €10 million)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Research Tax Credit (CIR) up to 30% of eligible R&D expenses; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) for SMEs; territorial aid for rail infrastructure projects; reduced rate for small businesses

tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal year ending 31 December, filing deadline is the second business day after 1 May; for other year-ends, within 3 months of the fiscal year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification (name, SIREN, address, legal form)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide French tax identification number (numéro fiscal) and permanent establishment details if applicable
Report French-source income attributable to the French permanent establishment; apply DTA provisions if relevant

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and credits (e.g., CIR, CII, loss carryforward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only credits available to non-residents; attach supporting documentation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable (impôt sur les sociétés) after credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute using standard rate or reduced rate if eligible; ensure withholding taxes on outbound payments are correctly reported

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of tax due, plus 0.4% per month of delay (capped at 10%); additional 10% penalty for failure to file after formal notice; interest on late payment at 0.2% per month

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 30% (12.8% income tax + 17.2% social levies) for non-resident shareholders
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding tax under a Double Tax Agreement (DTA), submit Form 5000 (for individuals) or Form 5001 (for companies) to the French tax authority, along with a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the shareholder's jurisdiction. The application must be filed before the dividend payment or within the statutory deadline for refund claims.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 33.33% (reduced to 0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive if beneficial owner is an EU affiliate); Interest: statutory 30% (reduced under DTA, often 0% for banks or 10% for others)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 400 million group turnover for Master File; EUR 50 million entity turnover for Local File; full documentation required if related-party transactions exceed EUR 100 million
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies general anti-abuse rules (e.g., substance-over-form) and requires real economic activity for tax residency and treaty benefits. No specific Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) like UAE, but the French tax administration may challenge entities lacking commercial substance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income, false invoicing, or concealment of assets
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to €500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; civil penalty of 40% to 80% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes if they participated in fraudulent acts; travel bans and asset freezes possible

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without real economic substance, lacking employees, premises, or business activity, solely to obtain tax benefits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of transactions, 40% penalty on re-assessed tax, and potential criminal charges for abuse of rights
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal liability for tax debts if the company is deemed a sham; possible prohibition from managing companies

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML controls, suspicious transaction reporting, or due diligence on clients in high-risk sectors
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €5 million or 5% of turnover; criminal penalties for money laundering up to 5 years imprisonment and €375,000 fine
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally fined and imprisoned; professional disqualification and travel bans may be imposed
